Dear Mr. Benson:
Subject: Draft Environmental Impact Statement - HR 1311 by Department of the Interior
This statement, in general, appears satisfactory to this Department.  However, from our view, the loss of management authority in fish and wildlife now vested in the states is clearly a detrimental aspect of the legislation.
Supposedly, the new amendments provide for the delegation of regulatory and management authority to a state "and utilization of state facilities and resources in carrying out the endangered species' conservation program", however, no mechanism appears evident to fund such activities or programs.
In addition, we would support the statement provided you by the Wash-ington Department of Game.
We appreciate the opportunity for comment you have afforded us.
Sincerely,
Thor C. Tollefson
